transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well… thank you for seeing me. I’m not trying to make a big fuss, but for months now there’s been this pattern I can’t really ignore. My sister’s appointments get moved, bills come in wrong, people say they’ll call me back and then they “forget.” Everyone keeps telling me it’s just mix-ups, and maybe that’s what they want me to think, but… I know information is being kept from me. It feels like they’re trying to push me out of decisions. Does that make sense?
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, I hear people talking in the normal way, of course, but not voices when I’m alone or anything like that. At least not that I’ve noticed. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Do you believe anyone is controlling your thoughts or putting thoughts into your mind?

No, I wouldn’t say anyone is putting thoughts in my head or controlling them. That sounds… more extreme than what I mean. It’s more that things keep happening around me in this pattern—my sister’s appointments getting moved, bills being wrong, people not calling back—and when they say it’s all just mistakes, I have a hard time accepting that. I feel like information is being kept from me, like I’m being pushed out of decisions. I know that may sound suspicious, but that’s what it feels like.
Do you think it is possible that you might be mistaken about people deliberately keeping information from you?

I mean… I suppose anything is possible. I don’t want to sound unreasonable. But after months of the same kinds of things happening—my sister’s appointments getting changed, bills coming in wrong, people saying they’ll call and then they don’t—it’s hard for me to believe it’s all just random mistakes.

So… maybe I could be missing something, but it really feels like information is being kept from me, and like I’m being pushed out of decisions. I hope that makes sense.
Are you certain that people are deliberately keeping information from you?

Certain is a strong word… I don’t want to sound like I’m accusing everyone. But yes, I do feel sure there’s more going on than they’re telling me.

It’s been months of the same things—my sister’s appointments being moved, bills showing up wrong, people saying they forgot to call me back. After a while it doesn’t feel like coincidence. It feels like information is being kept from me, and like they’re trying to push me out of decisions. I know that may not be what you want to hear, but that’s honestly how it seems to me.
Do you believe there is an organized group or conspiracy deliberately working against you?

I don’t know if I’d call it an organized group or a conspiracy… that sounds so harsh, and I don’t want to make it sound bigger than it is.

But I do believe people are deliberately keeping information from me. That’s why I’m here. For months it’s been the same pattern—my sister’s appointments get moved, bills are wrong, people “forget” to call me back—and everyone says it’s just mistakes. I’m sorry, but I just don’t believe that anymore. It feels like they’re trying to push me out of decisions.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high, energetic, or elated?

Um… not really, no. I mean, I’ve had days where I felt a little more productive or relieved if something went right, but I wouldn’t say unusually high or elated.

I hope that’s the kind of thing you mean. I don’t think I’ve had anything like that.
Have you been diagnosed with any brain or neurological illness, such as epilepsy, a head injury, or dementia?

No, not that I know of. I mean, I’ve never been told I had anything like epilepsy or dementia or… a brain illness.

I’ve had normal headaches now and then like anyone, but nothing I’d think of as neurological. If there’s something specific you mean, I can try to answer better.
Have you become less interested in seeing other people or doing your usual activities?

I don’t think so… not in a major way. I mean, I’m probably a little more selective lately about who I spend time with, just because some conversations feel tiring.

But I still do my usual things as much as I can. I wouldn’t say I’ve lost interest exactly. Does that answer what you’re asking?
Before these recent months, have you generally been a very distrustful person for most of your adult life?

No, I don’t think I was like that for most of my adult life. I mean, I’ve always tried to be careful and responsible, but not distrustful, I don’t think.

This has really been more… recent. Maybe about 11 months or so, since my sister’s health suddenly got worse and I had to start coordinating her care. That’s when I noticed I was more on edge about things. Does that make sense?
Aside from feeling that information is being kept from you, have you had any other unusual experiences that others would find hard to believe?

Not really unusual like… seeing things or anything, if that’s what you mean.

It’s more this pattern I keep noticing. My sister’s appointments get moved, bills come in wrong, people say they “forgot” to call me back. And I know everyone keeps saying it’s just mistakes or a busy office, but after months of it, it feels like information is being kept from me and like I’m being pushed out of decisions.

I don’t want to sound unreasonable. I’m just trying to explain what’s been happening.
Have you started using any drugs or new medications around the time these experiences began?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, I’m not using drugs, and I can’t think of any new medication that started right when all this began.

I’ve tried to think about that because I know it would matter, but nothing comes to mind. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you been hearing voices talking to you or about you?

No… I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices talking to me or about me.

I mean, sometimes I wonder what people are saying when I’m not included, but that’s not the same as hearing voices. I just want to be clear—I’m not hearing anything like that.
Have other people told you that you seem less expressive or show less emotion than you used to?

I don’t think anyone has said that to me, no. At least not in those words.

I mean, I may be more tired or careful about what I say lately, but I haven’t been told I seem flat or… less emotional. Does that answer what you’re asking?
Have you had any problems with your memory lately?

Not really, no. I mean, I misplace little things sometimes, like anyone does, but I haven’t noticed any real memory problem.

If there’s something specific you mean, I can try to think about it more.
Do you believe, despite what others tell you, that people are intentionally keeping information from you?

Yes… I mean, I don’t want to sound unreasonable, because I know people say these things are just mistakes. But it’s been happening for months now.

My sister’s appointments get moved, bills come in wrong, people say they “forgot” to call me back… and after a while it feels like a pattern. Even when everyone tells me it’s nothing, I do feel like information is being kept from me, like I’m being pushed out of decisions.

I’m trying to explain it calmly. Does that make sense?
Have these beliefs that people are deliberately keeping information from you been present continuously for more than three months?

Yes… I suppose it has been more than three months. I don’t want to overstate it, but it’s been going on about 11 months now, really since my sister’s health suddenly got worse and I had to start coordinating her care.

That’s when I started noticing it more consistently. Is that the kind of timeframe you mean?
Do you ever feel that other people can read your thoughts?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, I worry sometimes about what people think of me, but I don’t feel like they can actually read my thoughts.

That would be a different thing, right? I haven’t noticed anything like that.
